Status Launched, Functional & Publicly Accessible
Date October 2026
Domain Personal & Business Finance
Stack Python, SQLite, JavaScript, Claude Code
Live Product Renewals Product Page & Live Demo

Executive Summary

Managing recurring liabilities across SaaS, digital tools, telecommunications, insurance, and professional services is an operational blind spot for modern professionals and small business operators. While transaction records exist, they are scattered across vendor portals, PDF invoices, and disconnected spreadsheets, obscuring true historical expenditure and impending liabilities.

item.title: Under the Microscope Podcast: Amplifying the Technology Scientists Use to Accelerate Discovery
item.description:
Client: Park Systems
Service Provider: Dr. Pranoti Kshirsagar (The Science Talk)
Service: Science Podcast as a Service
Execution Period: 5 May 2025 to 19 May 2025

Executive Summary

The Under the Microscope podcast showcases innovative approaches to align research stakeholders, acting as an amplifier for the innovative technology scientists use to accelerate research and discovery. In this episode, Park Systems’ NX10 Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) appeared where it matters most: inside real research by Martin Rejhon at Charles University in Prague. One episode became 11 content assets across channels, generating more than 10,000 social media views and a 6% engagement rate on LinkedIn within two weeks.

item.title: ERC Projects Database: Research Tool for Scientists and Research Offices
item.description:
Last reviewed and updated on 27 October 2026.

Domain Focus: Scientific research funding and impact intelligence
Services: Data engineering and cleaning, information architecture, web development, technical SEO
Tools: Python, Google Sheets, Hugo, GitHub Pages, Claude Code, Google Search Console
Date: September 2026
Live page: pranoti.thesciencetalk.com/erc-projects-database

Executive Summary

Winning a European Research Council (ERC) grant takes precise positioning. Principal investigators and research offices must study the grants already funded in their scheme and panel to show novelty, frame ambition and benchmark a proposal. The data is public, in the European Commission’s Qlik dashboard, but that dashboard is dense, hard to filter and easy to lose your place in.

item.title: Claude Skills Registry: AI Governance for Companies
item.description:
Last reviewed and updated on 25 September 2026.

Date: April 2026
Domain Focus: AI Workflow Governance
Services: Workflow design, AI integration, process documentation
Tools: Claude (claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Claude Code), Google Sheets, Google Sheets MCP

Executive Summary

Claude skills change recurring tasks into consistent, repeatable workflows, from content production to analytics reports. When a skills library grows, the skills spread across claude.ai, local repositories, and temporary folders from Claude Code sessions. An update in one environment does not go to the other environments. Thus, it is difficult to know which version is current, which skills work, and which skills to retire.
